colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with PERFORMANCE PRO (Tech Messaging)

layouts.dashboard: Sidebar on left (w-64, fixed, hidden on mobile). Main content area on right with generous padding (p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-12).
layouts.bento_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 with gap-6 or gap-8 for metrics, status cards, and forms.
layouts.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px solid border-slate-800. No soft box-shadows. Use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl.
layouts.forms: Left-aligned labels, generous spacing (gap-6) between fields. Input fields: border-slate-800, bg-slate-900/50, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500.

components.sidebar: Dark minimal sidebar. Active navigation links should have a subtle background (bg-slate-900) and text-emerald-400 to indicate active state.
components.button: Rounded-lg or rounded-xl. Transitions on transform and background. active:scale-95.
components.table: Minimalist, no vertical borders. Subdued header text (uppercase, tracking-wider). Hover states on rows (hover:bg-slate-900/50).
components.qr_code_card: Centered layout inside the card, stark white background box for the QR code itself to ensure scannability, surrounded by the dark card.
components.status_badge: Small rounded-full badges with dot indicators. Emerald dot for Connected, Rose dot for Disconnected, Amber for Pending.
components.tabs: Use clean underlines or pill-shaped indicators for tab active states rather than heavy boxes.

motion.lists: Staggered entrance. For React: use standard CSS animations or framer-motion to slide in from bottom.
motion.dialogs: Fade in with a slight scale up (95% to 100%) and blur backdrop.

images.description: Abstract blue nodes and lines, to be used as a full-cover background image on the login page with a heavy slate/black overlay (bg-slate-950/80).
Neon 'hello' speech bubble to be used in empty states for message scheduling or chat lists to add a pop of color.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all icons. Keep size consistent (usually w-5 h-5). Do not use AI emojis.

specific_views.login: Split screen layout. Left side: The abstract login_background image with a dark overlay and brand typography. Right side: Login form vertically and horizontally centered in a clean, cardless layout.
specific_views.whatsapp_connect: Card displaying WhatsApp connection status and a dedicated space for the QR code. Use a crisp bordered white box for the QR code to ensure phone cameras can read it.
specific_views.telegram_connect: Form card requesting api_id, api_hash, and phone number. The UI should accommodate a secondary step/dialog for the login code once requested.
specific_views.message_composer: Clean textarea with an image upload drag-and-drop zone positioned beneath it. Include a prominent 'Send' button.
specific_views.telegram_relay: Two-pane layout or step-by-step wizard. Left/Step 1: Select Source Telegram Channel. Right/Step 2: Select Destination WhatsApp Group. Include a toggle to enable/disable relay.
specific_views.scheduler: Form to pick target group, select days of the week (using clickable day pills like [M] [T] [W] [T] [F] [S] [S]), time picker, and message content area.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use text-slate-50 for primary text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.interactive: Include focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 and focus:outline-none on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react, framer-motion, sonner, and react-router-dom if not already installed.
Set up the layout wrapper for the dashboard with a fixed sidebar and scrollable main area.
Apply 'Outfit' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text globally in your CSS.
For cards, use flat solid dark backgrounds (bg-slate-900) with a subtle 1px border (border-slate-800).
Do NOT use glassmorphism unless it's a sticky header.
Use sonner for toast notifications on actions like 'Message Sent' or 'Settings Saved'.
Build the dashboard fully responsive: sidebar should be hidden behind a hamburger menu on mobile.
Ensure the QR code area has a pure white background so it is readable by phone cameras.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their styles to match the dark slate/emerald theme.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like transform and colors.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories for images means DO NOT USE placeholder text.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
